column1: # THE GRAPHICS REGISTRY — every graphic this port has been OBSERVED to draw.
# Written by the game itself (sms-recomp/frame_interp/graphics_db.cpp). Rows are added automatically the first
# frame an emitter draws; measured columns are rewritten every run; the CURATED columns `re` and `note` are
# never touched by the game. Edit those with tools/gfx/graphics_db.py.
# WHAT THIS FILE DOES NOT SAY: a graphic that has never drawn in a recorded run is ABSENT, not "does not
# exist" — this is a census of what was observed. `lerp=unmeasured` means the interpolation audit filed
# nothing (the run had SBR_LERP60 off), NOT that the graphic snaps.
# re:   unknown | native-override (auto hints) | yes | partial | no | identified   (curated verdicts)
# lerp: yes | partial | camera-only | no | 2d-correct | unmeasured   (MEASURED, per run)
